I adopt the auditor's corrected reading of the decision rule: the applicable frozen clause is the first MIXED clause (C1 fails, C2-C5 partially satisfied), not the second. Four findings drive the decision. (1) C1's second conjunct is unsatisfied by every source: JSON-schema validity (80-94% over 110 internal compile attempts) is not a goal-to-artifact binding error rate; the audit's recomputed zero-shot end-to-end task success is 76.00%-90.24%; arXiv:2608.02680 explicitly publishes no compile/decline rate and its 0.992 is 'a reported observation, not an auditable measurement'; arXiv:2604.05150's 4% is a simulated ablation; arXiv:2607.04542 publishes gate refusal counts but binds by recording; arXiv:2605.04107 does not bind tasks. (3) Gate scoring must be corrected (mv1 PARTIAL, mv2 FAIL, mv5 PARTIAL, mv6 PARTIAL) and the frozen prereg consequence of any MV failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID) is applied to the runnability/C4 sub-measurement it actually invalidates, per audit unresolved[0]'s express reservation to the Director, while the primary-source extractions are preserved as raw evidence because the auditor reproduced them against the sources and the error direction is conservative. I therefore hold all three frozen claims at their current statuses, withdraw report.md Section 5's numeric targeting advice as unauthorized, authorize no product action and no promotion, and set continue=false because the next step is a NEW experiment that requires a fresh Global Research Director mandate - this handoff's next_question is a proposal, not an authorization, and no lane state or control-plane file was modified here.
